content:
maria-support: Customer reported a ~4k token invoice delta vs their local SDK estimator. Customer ID cust_9X7, request_id req_01GZ9XK. They included a short chat + a tool call that returns JSON with some base64 metadata. Can infra/eng triage?

oliver-eng: Can you paste the minimal repro payload + whether they used streaming? Also which SDK and tokenizer version?

maria-support: Repro (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-3b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Extract fields from this invoice image"}],"functions":[{"name":"run_ocr","parameters":{}}],"function_call":{"name":"run_ocr"}}'
```
They then got a tool response like:
```json
{"name":"run_ocr","content":"{\"text\":\"Invoice 123...\",\"attachments\":[{\"type\":\"image\",\"data\":\"<base64...>\"}],\"metadata\":{\"ocr_trace\":\"...\"}}"}
```
The SDK estimator (redwood-js v1.3.0) reported ~14k tokens. Invoice shows ~18.2k charged. Customer insists they didn't send the base64 in the request.

samir-qa: This pattern rings a bell — we've seen server-side prefills: we sometimes attach tool K/V metadata (content_metadata, attachment pointers) to the final model input for downstream logging/embedding, which is meterable. Often SDK estimators don't include server-injected JSON in their local tokenization pass.

billing-bot: metering-note: req_01GZ9XK traced. Preliminary: server-prefill +320 tokens from tool metadata; tool_response expansion +2.7k tokens. See internal trace ID mt_2026_18342.

oliver-eng: If the SDK is using tiktoken-js on the client, it will only see the original messages. The server can add a hidden prefill or expand the tool response for postprocessing, which will increase metered tokens. Could you ask for the exact SDK call (code snippet) and the full response body (redact images)?

maria-support: Customer used the browser SDK with default options, streaming disabled. Snippet they ran: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: '***'});
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rwd-neo-3b', messages: [{role: 'system', content: 'You are a helpful assistant.'}, {role: 'user', content: 'Extract fields from this invoice image'}], functions: [{name: 'run_ocr'}], function_call: {name: 'run_ocr'} });
console.log(res.usage); // shows tokens: 14012
```
They also shared the response payload (redacted) which includes a tool content string that itself is JSON with a base64 fragment. They say base64 came from downstream worker, not from them.

lev-evangelist: Two angles: 1) confirm whether server-side tool workers are attaching full payloads into the chat message (we used to attach attachments for search indexing). 2) confirm metering semantics: do we meter the final input to the model after any server-side expansions? I think yes — we meter the exact text tokens the model saw.

shreya: I'll open an internal ticket to eng-runtime and billing to confirm. Please attach: (a) the redacted full response body, (b) the customer's local SDK usage.log (res.usage and estimator snapshot), (c) time window and invoice snapshot.

maria-support: Uploaded docs to the ticket + link to customer's invoice in SF. Customer asks for a breakdown per-request; can we produce a per-request token audit (including server-prefill diffs)? :pray:

oliver-eng: We have a metering debug endpoint but it's gated. For now I can run a quick check — @billing-bot can you pull the meter trace for mt_2026_18342 and paste the expanded strings (redacted) that were fed to the model?

billing-bot: trace mt_2026_18342: 
- user_input (client): 3,210 tokens
- server_prefill: 320 tokens (metadata + logging preamble)
- tool_insertion_expansion: 4,450 tokens (tool JSON + base64 pointers)
- total metered: 7,980 tokens
(note: aggregated across retries/redirects equals invoice delta)

samir-qa: That matches. Short-term mitigation: recommend customers enable the SDK option skipServerPrefill:true (coming in v1.3.2) or call the metering-snapshot endpoint after call to fetch exact metered input. We'll push a docs blurb.

maria-support: Thanks — I'll share the interim mitigation and ETA to the customer. Please keep me posted on the internal ticket. :eyes:

oliver-eng: I filed ENG-9732 to ensure tool workers no longer inline large base64 blobs into model inputs; they'll instead store attachments in object store and include short pointers. Will track billing impact.

shreya: Assigning to eng-runtime and billing for final reconciliation.

maria-support: Closing loop with customer: gave explanation + temporary SDK setting. Customer is OK with that for now but requested a formal per-request audit for their invoice. We'll follow up once ENG has reconciliation.
